Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision
you were involved in in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: Sure. I'd rather just go by first name and last initial for this, if that's okay.
Q: That works. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center, pulling out of a row of spaces near the main entrance. It was a busy
afternoon and the lot was pretty crowded.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had just put my car in reverse and was backing out slowly. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and then the other
vehicle came around the end of the aisle and hit my rear passenger side.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe two or three miles an hour. I was barely moving.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: Briefly. We exchanged insurance information and he said he didn't see me coming either.
Q: Were you injured in the collision?
A: Yes. My neck snapped forward and then back, and my lower back has been sore ever since. I've been having
headaches too, and it's hard to turn my head to check blind spots when I drive.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and they diagnosed a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical
therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Yes, they've improved a little but I still have stiffness and pain, especially after sitting for long periods at work.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope the claim can be resolved so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
